name: Kotodama
source:
Because of past trauma main character can no longer believe in people. But there are people who really cherish for him - cousin, classmate and a childhood friend. Which counsel will he take on the way to recovery?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-august-2001-kimi-ga-nozomu.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
过去的创伤让主人公再也无法信任他人。不过，仍有人真心关怀着他——亲戚、同班同学，还有青梅竹马。在逐渐走出伤痛的过程中，他会听从谁的劝慰？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-august-2001-kimi-ga-nozomu.html]vndbreview[/url]]
